entry.name: Minh Van Do
entry.university: Singapore-MIT Alliance for Research and Technology

evidence.currentRole: https://m3s.mit.edu/our-team/do-van-minh — "Research Engineer". The employer identifies Do Van Minh as an M3S researcher. His linked personal site, https://minh.do/, records SMART employment from 2024 to present.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: https://m3s.mit.edu/our-team/do-van-minh lists two accepted 2026 conference papers, explicitly identifying him as a SMART author: (1) "4D Reconstruction with Events & RGB", ECCV 2026 Workshop on Neuromorphic Vision; (2) "Two-finger soft gripper with a scaled-pad contact interface for dual-mode grasping and surface cleaning", IROS 2026. These satisfy the brief's two-paper alternative; no doctorate is claimed.
evidence.vietnameseSignal: https://minh.do/ documents his bachelor's education at Danang University of Science and Technology, Vietnam, during 2011–2016. The employer uses Do Van Minh; its linked personal site uses Minh Do.
evidence.location: https://minh.do/ describes his current SMART workplace as "a research center of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) in Singapore".
evidence.dedup: Searched public/data.json for Minh Van Do, Van Minh Do, Do Van Minh, Minh Do, and all three identity URLs. Ran npm run find-roster-matches with both full-name orders and https://m3s.mit.edu/our-team/do-van-minh, https://minhdov.github.io/, and https://minh.do/. Matches vp-0005, vp-1599, and vp-2590 are different people: respectively an EPFL-trained UIUC professor, a Toronto-trained political scientist, and a Greenwich management researcher; this candidate has NTU engineering education and SMART robotics publications. No identity-URL match or matching name in already-proposed.txt.
